mechanism: Spironolactone is a potassium-sparing diuretic and mineralocorticoid antagonist that can increase serum potassium, while norethindrone (progestin) may also increase potassium retention through mineralocorticoid effects, creating additive hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; consider alternative contraception or adjust spironolactone dosing if hyperkalemia develops; assess renal function baseline and periodically.
